title: Kim Jong Un Orders Push for Absolute Superiority in AI Drone Defense
summary:
Pyongyang has called on its defense scientists to prioritize the integration of artificial intelligence and unmanned aircraft to modernize its security strategy and bolster the nation's nuclear arsenal. In a series of orders and at a recent weapons exhibition, Kim Jong Un demanded the achievement of "absolute superiority" in drone technology and AI defense to complement conventional military progress.

The directive comes as North Korea continues to test its missile capabilities, including the Oct. 29 firing of roughly 12 short-range ballistic missiles from the Wonsan area. South Korean officials identified the projectiles, which traveled about 250 km into the East Sea, as likely being KN-25 600mm multiple rocket launchers. The recent military activity coincides with ongoing border tensions, despite a recent proposal from Seoul to hold talks regarding a regional border dispute.

selectedTweets.text:
🇰🇵 Kim’s drone expo had rows of suicide drones and one of them looks a lot like Israel’s Harop 

The delta wing kamikaze drone in the photos closely resembles the Harop drone that circles over battlefields and then crashes into its target.

Or it could possibly be its Israeli cousin the Harpy NG, though nobody has confirmed what it actually is. 

In the background you can also make out the Saebyeol 4, a large unmanned reconnaissance aircraft, along with A LOT of other drones.

They are actively reverse engineering death drones at an alarming rate. 

Terrifying.

Source: @rockfish31 / Writer: Bri
